cleansingStrength.rationale: Low: genuinely mild architecture led by nonionic Decyl Glucoside #2 with mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate #3 and Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate #4 and emollient PEG-55 Propylene Glycol Oleate #5; no alkyl(ether) sulfate, limited anionic reset.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: two anionic routes; no amphoteric buffer

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: cleansing-led; only a late cationic starch (Hydroxypropyl Oxidized Starch PG-Trimonium Chloride #11, after preservatives) and trace Sodium Lactate #14.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: depositionLoad light (one late cationic starch), persistence low, resetCapacity weak-moderate; nothing to accumulate.

focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active: lead claim 'Schonende, seifenfreie Reinigung für empfindliche Kopfhaut' (explicit sensitive-scalp positioning) with scalpComfortTarget targeted (7.2 row). Mildness alone would not be a focus, but the claim names the sensitive scalp.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: no comfort active; Parfum #7 early; most claims are brand-level skin-barrier statements
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Sensitive-scalp claim + mild formula -> scalp_active; would fall to general if the claim were read as mildness-only.

focusSecondary.rationale: No distinct secondary positioning with an independent route.

usageRole.rationale: Frequent: 'Every-Day' name, 'für die tägliche Haarwäsche', and cleansingStrength low.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: explicit 'für empfindliche Kopfhaut' / 'schonend zur Kopfhaut' positioning with a supportive mild sugar-surfactant architecture at pH 5.5. Counter-signals: Parfum #7 early, no humectant/comfort active.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: fragrance prominent; support is mildness only

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C low). Ordinary target (S-FAIL), no T6. T4: no neighbors -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-SENSITIVE: E2 'empfindliche Kopfhaut' (manufacturer, E1 moderate) and targeted, but no E4 comfort route exists at all (prominent zone is #1-#6 before Parfum #7) -> gate fails. 'schützt Kopfhaut vor dem Austrocknen' is preventive, not an E2 dry-scalp claim; the dry gate would fail anyway (Sodium Lactate #14 not prominent). S-FAIL: propose ordinary + review_specialist_gate_failed (sensitive / comfort-route clause).
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 low -> gentle; differs from normal bucket's regular (I2 keeps it). I3: neighbor moderate -> regular would equal the projected bucket's expected intensity -> review_intensity_boundary.

uncertainties: S-FAIL routes a genuinely mild, sensitive-scalp-positioned product to ordinary (and its gentle intensity is amber there) because the E4 comfort list is closed; mild-surfactant architecture is not an E4 route. Standard gives no route for 'mildness as the comfort mechanism'.
E2 dry: 'schützt Kopfhaut vor dem Austrocknen' names the scalp and drying but is preventive; lexicon examples do not cover preventive phrasing.
§7.2: boundary between 'only mild/gentle cleansing positioning' (not a focus) and 'explicit sensitive scalp positioning' when the sensitive claim is the reason for mildness.
